full_prompt_en: A square old-master-like oil portrait shows a mature bearded man from the shoulders upward against a deep brown background. The backdrop is nearly empty and dark, changing only subtly from black at the upper left to warmer umber around the face. His head sits slightly left of center and turns toward the viewer with a mild angle. Thick gray-brown hair rises over the forehead and falls in rounded waves around both sides of the head, catching small silver highlights along individual curls. The face is lined and warmly modeled: a broad forehead, heavy lids, dark eyes, strong nose, and full mustache are visible above a large gray-white beard. The mustache curves across the upper lip, and the beard fans down over the dark garment to the lower edge. A narrow gray collar crosses beneath the hair at the shoulders, while the black coat loses definition as it merges into the surrounding shadow. There are no props, patterns, or other figures in the selected painting. The nearest details are concentrated around the eyes, nose, and beard texture; the outside of the hair and shoulders softens gradually into the background. Fine paint grain and small brushed strands give the beard a tactile surface, contrasting with smoother skin tones and velvety dark clothing. Warm light comes from the upper left and front, brightening the forehead, nose ridge, cheeks, and top curls, then fading along the beard and coat. The right side of the face retains enough reflected warmth to remain legible without becoming evenly lit. The overall composition is compact and solemn, using a small illuminated oval within expansive brown-black shadow to give the sitter quiet gravity.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、近似古典大师油画的肖像描绘一位成熟的蓄须男子，从肩部以上在深褐色背景前显现。背景几乎空无一物，只有左上近黑色向脸旁较暖赭褐细微变化。头位于中央稍偏左处，略转角朝向观者。浓密灰褐头发在额上隆起，在头两侧以圆润波浪垂下，独立发卷边缘接住少量银色高光。面庞有皱纹且以暖色塑形：宽额头、厚眼睑、深眼睛、挺鼻和饱满唇髭立于大块灰白胡须上方。唇髭在上唇处弯曲，胡须扇形垂过深衣，延至下缘。细灰领从肩部头发下横过，黑外套逐渐失去边界，与周围阴影融合。所选画面中没有道具、花纹或其他人物。最近的细节集中在眼、鼻与胡须肌理，头发和肩部外缘逐渐软化进入背景。细颜料颗粒与短刷发丝给胡须以可触表面，对照较平滑的肤色和柔绒般深衣。暖光从左上及前方照来，提亮额头、鼻梁、面颊和顶部卷发，随后沿胡须与外套衰减。脸右侧保留足够暖色反光而可辨，却未变成均匀照亮。整体构图紧凑肃穆，以宽阔褐黑阴影中的一小块受光椭圆赋予人物安静的分量。
style_prompt_en: The image has a low-key oil-painted finish, combining smooth warm modeling with fine fibrous strokes and velvety dark passages. Umber, charcoal, gray-brown, cream, and small amber highlights form a narrow tonal range. The focus emerges gradually from a broad shadow field, with the crispest detail near the center and dissolving edges toward the perimeter. Directional warm light touches raised planes and textured strands while the lower and farther areas retain deep, subtly colored shadow. Surface grain stays restrained and natural, avoiding both flat black and glossy polish. The overall effect is intimate and weighty, organized by a compact luminous core surrounded by quiet darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 图像有低调油画完成面，平滑暖色塑形与细纤维状笔触、柔绒般深色通道结合。赭褐、炭灰、灰褐、奶油与少量琥珀高光形成狭窄色调范围。焦点逐渐从宽阔阴影场中显现，中心细节最清楚，边缘向外围溶解。暖色定向光触及凸起平面与带纹理的丝状细节，下部和远侧保留深而略带色彩的阴影。表面颗粒克制自然，既不平黑也不光滑抛光。整体效果亲密而有重量，以紧凑发光核心环绕于安静黑暗中组织。
theme_en: A gray-haired bearded man emerging from a deep brown backdrop
theme_zh: 灰发蓄须男子从深褐背景中显现
name: Nicolaes van Verendael
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
